groups.label: Word Stress, Schwa & Sentence Rhythm
groups.definition: English stress-timed rhythm: stressing content words, unstressing function words with Schwa /ə/, and shifting stress in derivatives.
rules: Nouns & Occupations: 1st syllable stress (DOC-tor, TEA-cher, WA-ter).
Schwa /ə/: unstressed vowel sound in words like doctor /ˈdɒk.tə/ or about /əˈbaʊt/.
Contrastive stress: emphasizing contrasting words (I said RED, not BLUE).
